name: Tomato Soup No. 2
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: hot boiled milk
ingredients.originalText: a quart of hot boiled milk

ingredients.name: piece of butter the size of an egg
ingredients.originalText: a piece of butter the size of an egg

instructions.text: Place over the fire a quart of peeled tomatoes.
Stew them soft with a pinch of soda.
Strain it so that no seeds remain.
Set it over the fire again.
Add a quart of hot boiled milk.
Add a piece of butter the size of an egg.
Add three tablespoonfuls of rolled cracker.
Canned tomatoes may be used in place of fresh ones.

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Place over the fire a quart of peeled tomatoes.
2. Stew them soft with a pinch of soda.
3. Strain it so that no seeds remain.
4. Set it over the fire again.
5. Add a quart of hot boiled milk.
6. Season with salt and pepper.
7. Add a piece of butter the size of an egg.
8. Add three tablespoonfuls of rolled cracker.
9. Serve hot.
10. Canned tomatoes may be used in place of fresh ones.
